senses.gloss:
नि-हित, अस्, आ, अम्, put down, deposited, &c.
See s. v.

निहित नि-हित, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. 1. नि-धा),
[]
placed, laid, fixed, lodged, situated, deposited, de-
livered, given, intrusted; inserted, infixed, attached;
applied to; bestowed upon; treasured up; held;
laid (as dust by rain); uttered in a deep tone.
—निहित-दण्ड, अस्, आ, अम्, one who lays aside the
rod, one who shows clemency.
—निहित-नयन,
अस्, आ, अम्, having the eyes fixed or directed upon
(with loc.).

निह् निह्, Ved. = नि-हन्तृ (according to
Mahī-dhara).

निहन् 1. नि-हन्, cl. 2. P. -हन्ति, -हन्तुम्,
to strike down, strike, kill, destroy; to strike in,
fix in, infix; to disregard, neglect: Caus. -घात-
यति, -यितुम्, to kill, destroy.
2. नि-हन्, आ, m. a killer, destroyer.

नि-हत, अस्, आ, अम्, struck down, stricken,
smitten, killed, slain, overcome; struck into, infixed;
attached, devoted.
—निहत-भूयिष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्,
having the greater number killed.
—निहत-सेन,
अस्, आ, अम्, having (their) armies smitten or destroyed.
—निहतोष्ट्र (˚त-उष्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, having the
camels killed, whose camels have been slain.
नि-हनन, अम्, n. killing, slaughter, murder.

नि-हन्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be struck down, to
be killed or destroyed.

नि-हन्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, who or what kills or
destroys, a killer; destructive, murderous; one who
removes or dispels or hinders.

नि-हन्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being struck down
or killed.
निहव नि-हव. See नि-ह्वे, p. 511, col. 1.

नि-हव, अस्, m. invocation, calling, summoning,
calling near; N. of a Sāman, (वसिष्ठस्य नि-
हवस् or वसिष्ठ-निहवस्.)

निहा नि-हा, Pass. -हीयते, &c., to be de-
prived of.

निहाका, f., Ved. a storm, whirlwind, &c.; (Sāy.)
an iguana, the Gangetic alligator.

नि-हीन, अस्, आ, अम्, low, vile, of low origin;
(अस्), m. a low man, an outcast.

निहीन नि-हीन. See under नि-हा, p. 510,
col. 3.

निहिंसन नि-हिंसन, अम्, n. killing,
slaughter.

निहृ नि-हृ, cl. 1. P. A. -हरति, -ते, -हर्-
तुम्, Ved. to offer, give.
नि-हार, अस्, m. = नी-हार, q. v.

नीहार नी-हार, अस्, m. (fr. rt. हृ with नि?),
fog, mist; frost, hoar-frost, heavy dew; evacuation.
—नीहार-कर, अस्, m. ‘dew-maker’ or ‘cold-
rayed,’ the moon.

नि-हारिन्. See निर्-हारिन् under निर्-हृ, p. 502,
col. 3.

निह्नु नि-ह्नु, cl. 2. A. -ह्नुते, -ह्नोतुम्, to
disown, deny, dissimulate, conceal, evade.

नि-ह्नव, अस्, m. denial, concealment, hushing
up, dissimulation; concealment in general, secrecy;
mistrust, doubt, suspicion; a secret; wickedness;
atonement, expiation; excuse, exculpation, depre-
cation; N. of a ceremony; N. of a Sāman.
—नि-
ह्नव-वादिन्, ई, m. a defendant or witness who
prevaricates or tries to hide the truth.
—निह्नवोत्-
तर (˚व-उत्˚), अम्, n. an evasive reply or defence.

नि-ह्नुत, अस्, आ, अम्, denied, disowned, evaded;
concealed, secreted.

नि-ह्नुति, इस्, f. denial or concealment of know-
ledge; dissimulation, reserve, secrecy; hiding, con-
cealment.

नि-ह्नुवन, अम्, n. denial or concealment of
knowledge; excuse, exculpation.

नि-ह्नुवान, अस्, आ, अम्, dissimulating, prevari-
cating, insinuating, using double entendre.

निह्राद नि-ह्राद, अस्, m. (fr. rt. ह्राद् with
नि), sound; (also read निर्-ह्राद.)
—निह्राद-वत्,
आन्, अती, अत्, sounding, making a noise.
नि-ह्रादिन्, ई, इनी, इ, sounding, pealing.

निह्वे नि-ह्वे, cl. 1. P. A. -ह्वयति, -ते,
-ह्वातुम्, to invoke, call.

नीहाराय, Nom. A. नीहारायते, &c., to make
frost.
